visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens in a bright studio where a man with styled black hair and a black t-shirt looks directly at the camera with an expression of shock. Yellow jagged graphic overlays appear around his head to emphasize his surprise. The scene quickly cuts to a split-screen comparison showing a man's bare torso, highlighting a weight loss transformation between two different timeframes. (2) A close-up shot features hands roughly pinching the abdominal fat of a man wearing a white t-shirt, emphasizing physical bulk. This is followed by a transition to an outdoor urban street where the man is seen running in slow motion, pursued by a Corgi dog. The background shows parked motorcycles and residential buildings under bright daylight. (3) The setting shifts to an indoor kitchen area with a wine rack. The host holds a white and red package of porridge, pouring its contents into a green ceramic bowl. He then places the bowl into a modern black microwave with copper dials to demonstrate ease of preparation. (4) The scene transitions to a gym with yellow equipment and mirrored walls. A young man lies on a bench, struggling to lift a barbell. The host and a woman in workout attire stand over him, shouting and gesturing wildly to provide motivation. Facial expressions are strained and high-energy. (5) A woman in a black shirt and white skirt is seen in a domestic setting, adding canned corn and tuna into a pot of the prepared porridge. She tastes it with a spoon and gives a thumbs-up. The trio then performs a synchronized dance routine in a brightly lit studio space with wood floors. (6) The final phase returns to the studio where a group of people, including the main characters and background staff, hold up product packages. They smile and cheer towards the camera. Graphic overlays displaying brand logos and nutritional facts occupy the lower and upper sections of the frame.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) High-energy electronic BGM kicks in with a driving beat. A male narrator delivers rapid-fire Traditional Chinese speech with an enthusiastic, high-pitched tone. A synthesized 'whoosh' sound marks the first visual scene transition. (2) A comical 'pop' UI sound effect is heard as the narrator's voice becomes exaggerated and whiny during a close-up visual. The BGM maintains a steady 128 BPM tempo with bright synth textures. (3) The acoustic environment shifts slightly to include faint outdoor street noise and the sound of heavy breathing and rhythmic footsteps, while the narrator continues with high-arousal vocal delivery. (4) A sharp mechanical click of a microwave button followed by a brief low hum and a metallic 'ping' stinger occurs. The vocal tone shifts to a professional, enunciated promotional style detailing food ingredients. (5) Strained vocal grunting and short shouts of 'Jia you!' from multiple voices are heard during the gym sequence, overlapping with the loud, percussive music bed. (6) A sequence of rapid 'ding' sound effects accompanies each nutritional point listed by the speaker. The track ends with a collective cheer from the group and a bright, percussive final jingle.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To promote 'Kibun' brand red quinoa oat porridge as a tasty and effective tool for weight loss, demonstrating its convenience and nutritional value through a 20-day challenge narrative.
